text:
Rickard Rakell's season comes with a trade story. Pittsburgh is losing, he's a 33-year-old scoring winger, and this week Yahoo Sports and others relayed a rumor that he had blocked a trade to Chicago. None of that is confirmed by the Penguins, but it's the backdrop.

His play makes the interest easy to understand. He has six goals, all in his last ten games, on 19:45 a night, and they're not a fluke: 6.5 expected goals (the quality of his chances) for the season and a 13% shooting rate, right at league average. Our wins-added numbers rank him 37th of 522 skaters, because his goals have come at moments that mattered.

The rest of his line is thinner, five assists, and Pittsburgh is about four points worse in five-on-five chance share with him than without. Evolving-Hockey had him facing top-of-the-lineup competition last season, in the 97th percentile. Watch the next few weeks: his market depends on the goals continuing, and the Penguins' plans depend on the standings.
headline: Rakell keeps scoring through the trade talk
